mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation models, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days across all macro regimes.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over 5-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 5.0% over a 3-month period, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce corporate profit growth expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, which triggers a sell-off in equities as corporate revenue growth expectations fall, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the interaction term's coefficient in a regression is not statistically significant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes (GDPC1 > 11200 and UNRATE < 4.5%), a decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 109.0) signals an economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When the core inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3.0% annually, it signals persistent inflation that prompts the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.0%, or the Rank IC over 5-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in employment (PAYEMS) consistently signals robust labor market conditions that support corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days across all macro regimes.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS increases, or the Rank IC over 5-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 2200.0 thousand units, it indicates a contraction in the residential construction sector that reduces consumer wealth and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when HOUST < 2200.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production (INDPRO) and quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) signal a severe economic contraction, reducing corporate profit expectations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when both INDPRO and GDPC1 decline, or the interaction term's coefficient in a regression is not statistically significant (p>0.05).
